name: Replication data for: Non-uniqueness of the Equilibrium in Lewis and Schultz's Model
description: The source code below is used for the simulations reported in Jo (2011, Non-uniqueness of the Equilibrium in Lewis and Schultz's Model). The simulation is intended to show that when there are multiple equilibria, the parameter estimates may not get closer to their true values even if the number of observations increases.
citation: Jinhee Jo, 2011, "Replication data for: Non-uniqueness of the Equilibrium in Lewis and Schultz's Model", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/BVVYXJ, Harvard Dataverse, V1
